text:
deploybot: starting pin rollout runtime-3.2 -> runtime-3.2 (group: llama3q-quant). request=rb-5281234567 state=drain :loudsound:

maria.g: noticing repeated warmup failures on canaries in eu-west-2, pin progress stalled at ~39% and some pods keep restarting. logs show kvcache invalidation traces.

aj: confirmed. longseq K/V warmups hitting ‘segment allocation failed’ and kernel warnings. suggest temporary traffic steering first, avoid full cancel unless errors spike.

deploybot: note: abort is destructive while drain-phase=on. manual `pin cancel --force` allowed but may drop inflight.

eli.sre: telemetry - error-rate up from 0.9% -> 7.6% for llama3q within 4m. latency tail increased. propose: 1) create temporary routing rule to runtime-3.1 for llama3q, 2) keep pin drain but prevent new routable objects to affected pool, 3) run added memory/core capture.

kate.pm: agree. minimal customer impact is priority. I'll draft a short support note and stand by support channel.

maria.g: aj, can you apply the route? include a 1h TTL then reassess.

aj: running:
```
/routes apply --scope model:llama3q-quant --from runtime-3.2 --to runtime-3.1 --duration 3600 --reason "kvcache/kernels mismatch" --meta "temp-fallback"
```

aj: applied, rerouted ~9.4k reqs, change=rout-5281234568 ✅

sre-bot: Alert -> after reroute error-rate for llama3q dropped to 1.0% in 90s, median latency improved ~160ms.

maria.g: good signal. keep drain running but hold on force cancel. we'll collect traces for 30m and decide: rollback pin vs. patch shim.

aj: added deploybot annotation to exclude:model=llama3q-quant from auto-pin waves until cleared. ticket: https://redwood.local/ops/528123-lm-rlg

kate.pm: posting support blurb now and scheduling 15m sync if we need rollback window.

eli.sre: follow-ups: add pre-pin smoke test for longseq warmups, add compat-flag to pinlist for kvcache-hotpath models, and schedule micro-PM. filing follow-up PRs.

maria.g: thanks. marking thread monitored; will reopen if error-rate >5% or reroute TTL expires with bad signal. :thumbsup:
